QEVA

About

QEVA connects mathematical definitions with bounded computational experiments.

Explore and compare

Choose a system in the Lab, change its parameters, compare observations, and inspect the results. Runs can be exported for reproduction and saved in the current browser.

The concept map connects definitions and interpretations. The history view provides a separate selection of recorded developments.

Interpreting evidence

A computation establishes results within its stated domain, numerical conventions and resource bounds. It does not establish claims about untested cases. Each record identifies its assumptions and review or verification status.

Logical dependencies, explanatory links and historical influences are different relationships. The current collection is incomplete; unresolved references and candidate connections remain identified.

Records and privacy

Mathematical records and experiments can be read or downloaded without an account. Browser-local saving is not cloud storage or synchronization. Browser data may be cleared or accessed by other users of the same profile; do not store secrets.

Source specifications and archival exports are available in the archive and protocol documentation.

QEVAClaims remain challengeable; exact history remains addressable.
